description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaPipelineTestBase class, which provides a base for unit testing media pipeline components. It includes mock setup, media pipeline creation and destruction, and methods to simulate media source attachment, EOS handling, and data notification within a test environment.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing common setup, teardown, and utility methods for media pipeline unit tests.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects and internal state.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Sets up and creates a media pipeline instance with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the media pipeline instance.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task and waiting on the main thread.

methods.name: loadGstPlayer
methods.description: Loads a mock GStreamer player and initiates media loading.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source (audio/video) to the pipeline.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Simulates end-of-stream for a media source.

methods.name: expectNotifyNeedData
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying the need for media data.

methods.name: expectNotifyNeedDataEos
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying end-of-stream media data.
